It is too often forgotten in top-dressing of the roots that the trees have a double operation. The annual growths of the tree grow in checked growth in proportion to the annual and other dressings of the soil, and excreta of birds and other animals, all tend to clothe the trees with surface roots of a lesser depth and inferior quality of these. It is very apt to be overlooked by any cultivator of trees who may notice the slower growth of trees in isolated positions as compared with those in clumps. But the explanation generally is that the disparity has been caused because the trees grow in checked growth in proportion as the woods were top-dressed. It may, however, be but a lesser part of the evil, for the woods were top-dressed, and may have been started on a course worse than this. The prospects of the Menominee and other streams tributary to Green Bay, are really not so encouraging as a few weeks ago, as logs on the first-named stream, which were then considered safe, are now spoken of as very doubtful. There is no water and no prospect of any. The drive on the Muskegon, the largest stream sending stock to this market is progressing so slowly that unless heavy rains ensue, the logs will not reach the mills much before shutting-down time.
